question: What does v sign in front of mouth mean?

report.answer_text:
If someone sticks their tongue out between the two fingers, it’s usually a crude gesture suggesting oral sex, specifically cunnilingus. (en.wiktionary.org)
If they’re just holding a V near their lips, especially in a selfie, it may simply be a playful peace-sign pose. The placement alone doesn’t make it sexual. (vice.com)
